title: Grand Slam Arena
intro: Minutes before the final whistle, the championship trophy vanished from the locked arena vault.

cast.name: Riley Rook
cast.alibi: Was recording the crowd chant from the press box.
cast.fact: Riley once covered a match under a false name.

cast.name: Jordan Vale
cast.alibi: Was retaping a lucky wristband in the locker room.

cast.name: Morgan Pike
cast.alibi: Was checking the tunnel lights before halftime.
cast.fact: Morgan has a spare key to every service door.

cast.name: Avery Lane
cast.alibi: Was repairing the mascot head backstage.
cast.fact: Avery is allergic to the arena fog machine.

cast.name: Casey Flint
cast.alibi: Was scanning late arrivals at Gate C.
cast.fact: Casey saw someone leave the vault corridor.

cast.name: Taylor Moss
cast.fact: Taylor can identify the trophy polish by smell.

cast.name: Quinn Park
cast.alibi: Was signing programmes by the sponsor wall.
cast.fact: Quinn has a large unpaid betting debt.

cast.name: Skyler Dean
cast.alibi: Was resetting a breaker near the scoreboard.
cast.fact: Skyler disabled a camera earlier that day.

cast.name: Rowan Bell
cast.alibi: Was reviewing plays in the video room.
cast.fact: Rowan argued with the captain before the match.

cast.name: Emery Cole
cast.alibi: Was greeting sponsors in the atrium.
cast.fact: Emery approved the vault's maintenance schedule.
